providers.name: Hims
providers.summary: The biggest name in men's telehealth. Wide hair menu, free consult, and introductory prices that rise after the first plan.

oral_finasteride.note: $22-26 on a 3-month plan; about $25 month to month

topical_fin_min.note: Compounded 0.3% finasteride / 6% minoxidil spray or serum; $35 on a 5-month plan, about $50 monthly

oral_minoxidil.note: Prescribed off-label after consult; price not published

bundle.note: Hair Kit (finasteride + minoxidil + biotin + shampoo) $44-49 billed quarterly; Hair Power Pack $50-80

providers.billing: Monthly or quarterly plans; the advertised 'from' price is the longest commitment on a single medication
providers.cancel_policy: Cancel from your account; no refunds on opened medication (confirm in current terms)
providers.states_note: Availability varies by state for some products
providers.watch_out: The headline 'from $20/mo' applies to the cheapest medication on the longest plan; most subscribers pay more after the first cycle. Hims' overall Trustpilot profile was 3.0 across 8,286 reviews in an August 2026 check.

affiliate.note: $175 CPA listed on the network's hair-loss page

providers.name: Keeps
providers.summary: Hair-only platform for men. Usually the cheapest generic finasteride subscription; billed quarterly with a $5 shipping fee per shipment.

oral_finasteride.note: Reported at $16, $20 and $25 by different sources in 2026; billed quarterly

oral_dutasteride.note: Only inside the compounded Chew+ / Drop+ formulations added in 2026

providers.billing: Billed every 3, 6 or 12 months; each shipment is a 3-month supply; longer commitments are discounted
providers.cancel_policy: Pause or cancel anytime from your account, no cancellation fee
providers.refund_policy: 180-day money-back guarantee introduced in 2026, with conditions
providers.states_note: Some states excluded; list not published in one place
providers.watch_out: No topical finasteride as of early 2026. Three third-party sources give three different finasteride prices, and one competitor's comparison page shows three different starting prices on a single page. Check the checkout figure, not the headline.

providers.name: Ro (Roman)
providers.summary: One of the original men's telehealth platforms. No commitment, cancel after one order, and a 3-in-1 spray that adds tretinoin.

oral_finasteride.note: From about $15-16 according to two sources; another reports $30-50

oral_minoxidil.note: Offered off-label; ro.co notes the black-box warning

providers.cancel_policy: Cancel anytime, including after the first order
providers.states_note: Physician oversight in all US states
providers.watch_out: The widest price spread between sources of any provider here. Treat every Ro figure as provisional until checked at checkout.

affiliate.note: $5 per lead / $40 CPA on the network page; a competitor discloses $50-120 per signup

providers.name: Happy Head
providers.summary: Dermatologist-founded compounding platform for men and women. The strongest topical concentrations in the category, priced accordingly.

topical_fin_min.note: Topical Rx (up to 8% minoxidil + finasteride, retinoic acid, hydrocortisone) $79-99 on subscription, $99 one-time; with latanoprost $149

topical_dutasteride.note: Topical dutasteride + minoxidil $89; dutasteride + finasteride + minoxidil $119

providers.consult_fee: Free dermatology questionnaire; topical pricing is shown only after it
providers.billing: Monthly subscription; pause, skip or cancel anytime; 20% off the first month is a recurring promotion
providers.refund_policy: Refund of the most recent month's supply within 6 months if unsatisfied
providers.watch_out: Topical prices are hidden until you finish the questionnaire. Most customers who take a topical and an oral product land at $79-149 a month once the first-month promotion ends.

affiliate.note: $40 CPA default, higher rates case by case

providers.name: Strut Health
providers.summary: A licensed compounding-pharmacy platform with the deepest menu here: 13 men's hair products, a women's formula, dutasteride in both forms, and the cheapest oral minoxidil found.

topical_finasteride.note: Hairfect Rx 5-in-1 (0.25% finasteride, 7.5% minoxidil, tretinoin, fluocinolone, biotin) $59-69 per 30 days

topical_fin_min.note: Same 5-in-1 gel; minoxidil 0-7.5% chosen by the physician

topical_dutasteride.note: 0.1% dutasteride gel with optional minoxidil, tretinoin, fluocinolone, biotin; $69

spironolactone.note: Women's Hair Growth Formula (spironolactone, finasteride, minoxidil, fluocinolone, tretinoin, biotin) $59

bundle.note: Hairfect combo + StrutVite $79; latanoprost Hair Booster $49 / $99

providers.consult_fee: Free; charged only if the physician approves treatment
providers.watch_out: A $40 physician consultation fee is charged if you move the prescription to a pharmacy other than Strut's preferred one.

affiliate.note: Strut runs GLP-1 offers on the network; hair offer to confirm

providers.name: XYON Health
providers.summary: Compounded topicals in a patented slow-release gel, prescribed after a dermatologist consultation. The most expensive topicals in the category.

topical_finasteride.note: SiloxysSystem gel; about $99 per month, $297 per quarter

topical_fin_min.note: Gel and solution versions offered; price shown after intake

spironolactone.note: Oral spironolactone offered to women; price shown after intake

providers.consult_fee: Dermatologist consultation; pricing revealed after intake
providers.watch_out: Prices are not shown on product pages. Two to three times the cost of standard-strength topicals; make sure standard options have been tried first.

providers.name: Hers
providers.summary: The women's side of Hims & Hers. Cheap topical minoxidil, a multi-ingredient hair blend, and prescription options after a free consult.

bundle.note: Hair Blend solution (minoxidil, biotin, ketoconazole, B5) $39

providers.watch_out: Same parent company as Hims. Check which products are prescription-only and which are over-the-counter before comparing prices.

affiliate.note: Hims & Hers; hair CPA to confirm

providers.name: Oana Health
providers.summary: Women's hormonal-health telehealth (PCOS, menopause). The cheapest oral spironolactone found anywhere in this index.
providers.watch_out: Prices come from Oana's own blog (January 2026), not a checkout page.

providers.name: Musely
providers.summary: Compounded oral and topical dutasteride formulas with separate men's and women's lines, sold as 3-month supplies.

spironolactone.note: Women's oral (dutasteride + spironolactone + minoxidil) $29; women's topical $30

providers.billing: Starts with a 3-month supply paid up front
providers.watch_out: Three months paid up front. The source for these prices is from April 2025 and is the oldest in this index.

providers.name: Lemonaid Health
providers.summary: An older telehealth platform. Half-price first shipment, then the standard rate; no prescription minoxidil in 14 states.

oral_finasteride.note: $60 per 3-month supply ($30 for the first 3 months)

topical_fin_min.note: 3-in-1 spray (finasteride, minoxidil, tretinoin) and a finasteride + minoxidil foam; prices to confirm

providers.states_note: No prescription minoxidil in the states listed
providers.watch_out: The introductory price halves the first shipment and the second shipment doubles it, the classic month-two jump.

affiliate.note: Appears on the network for GLP-1; hair offer to confirm

providers.name: MangoRx
providers.summary: A single chewable (minoxidil, finasteride, biotin, vitamin D3) from a small NASDAQ-listed company. Convenient, expensive, not available in nine states.

bundle.note: GROW chewable from $90 per month, 30/60/90-day tins

providers.states_note: Not available in the states listed
providers.watch_out: About $3 per tablet, several times the cost of the same generics elsewhere. Mangoceuticals had a market value of roughly $5 million in August 2026.

affiliate.note: Appears on the network for GLP-1; hair offer to confirm

providers.name: Dr. B
providers.summary: Not a subscription: a $19 online consultation, then you fill the prescription at your own pharmacy. Compare it on annual cost, not monthly.

oral_finasteride.note: $7-45 per month at a pharmacy after the $19 consult; this is a pharmacy price, not a subscription

oral_minoxidil.note: Can be covered by the same consult; pharmacy price

oral_dutasteride.note: Can be covered by the same consult; pharmacy price

providers.watch_out: A different model. The $7 figure is what a pharmacy charges with a discount card; your total is consult plus pharmacy.
